_doc: Geographic region taxonomy for the /listings/sold/ dropdown. Cities with 50+ sales in the 2-year sold cache get their own dropdown entry (major centres). Everything else rolls up into one of these regions for browsable filtering. Built 2026-05-11 from the live sold-cache inventory. Mike: review the region definitions + the `members` lists. Catch-all for small communities not explicitly listed = postal-prefix fallback at the bottom.
_authoring_principles: Regions follow standard NL geographic conventions (Avalon Peninsula, Burin Peninsula, Bonavista Peninsula, etc.) rather than NLAR sub-districts (which Mike noted are 'a mess' in the Angie thread).
Major centres at threshold 50+ sales get their own dropdown entry — appears in 'Major centres' section of dropdown.
All other communities roll up into their region — appears in 'Regions' section of dropdown.

Region membership is INCLUSIVE of the major centres geographically located there (so 'Avalon Peninsula' includes St. John's, but St. John's also appears as its own dropdown entry above). When a consumer selects 'Avalon Peninsula' they get ALL Avalon sales including St. John's; when they select 'St. John's' they get just St. John's. This is consumer-natural — selecting a broader bucket shouldn't exclude bigger places inside it.
Postal-prefix fallback at bottom of file catches any community not explicitly named in `members` lists. Defensive against new cities appearing in the feed.

Avalon Peninsula.description: St. John's metro + Conception Bay + Trinity Bay east + Southern Shore (everything on the easternmost peninsula of NL).

Burin Peninsula.description: South-coast peninsula extending southwest from the mainland of insular NL — Marystown, Burin, Grand Bank, Fortune, St. Lawrence area.

Bonavista Peninsula.description: East-coast peninsula northeast of Trinity Bay — Bonavista, Trinity, Port Rexton, Catalina, Elliston, English Harbour.

Central NL — Gander Area.description: Turner Realty's primary service territory. Gander + the Gander Loop + the Road to the Isles + the Eastport Peninsula + the Notre Dame Bay east outports.

Central NL — Exploits Valley.description: Grand Falls-Windsor area + the Exploits River valley + Notre Dame Bay west outports.

Notre Dame Bay — West.description: North-coast outports west of Twillingate — Springdale + Triton + La Scie + Baie Verte Peninsula.

Connaigre Peninsula / South Coast Centra.description: South-coast communities accessible by road or coastal ferry — Hermitage, Harbour Breton, Belleoram, Pool's Cove + Bay D'Espoir corridor + Connaigre Bay.

Western NL — Humber Valley & Bay of Isla.description: Corner Brook + Deer Lake + Pasadena + the Humber River valley + Bay of Islands communities.

Western NL — Bay St. George & South Coas.description: Stephenville + Stephenville Crossing + the Codroy Valley + Channel-Port aux Basques + south coast communities.

Northern Peninsula.description: Long north-pointing peninsula from Deer Lake up to St. Anthony + the Strait of Belle Isle coast.

Labrador — Central (HVGB).description: Happy Valley-Goose Bay + North West River + Sheshatshiu + Mud Lake + Lake Melville communities.

Labrador — West.description: Labrador City + Wabush + Churchill Falls (iron-ore mining communities + hydro company town).

Labrador — Coastal.description: Coastal Labrador — South Coast (Forteau / L'Anse au Loup / Mary's Harbour) + North Coast (Nain / Hopedale / Makkovik / Postville / Rigolet).

fsa_prefix_fallback._doc: Defensive: if a city in the cache is not explicitly listed in any region's `members`, derive its region from this postal-prefix-to-region map. Catches new cities the feed picks up.

fsa_prefix_fallback.A2H: Western NL — Humber Valley & Bay of Islands
fsa_prefix_fallback.A2N: Western NL — Bay St. George & South Coast

_review_notes: Top region misclassifications I want Mike's eyes on:

1. A0H is split between Exploits Valley (Bishop's Falls/Botwood) and Connaigre Peninsula (Hermitage/Harbour Breton) — same postal prefix covers both, so the postal-fallback alone can't distinguish them. The `members` lists in each region are the disambiguator. Worth Mike's review.
2. A0L is split between Humber Valley/Bay of Islands AND Northern Peninsula (Rocky Harbour, Bonne Bay) — same problem. Members lists disambiguate.
3. A0K covers both Notre Dame Bay West AND Northern Peninsula (some) AND Coastal Labrador — three regions on one prefix. Members lists are critical here.
4. 'Massey Drive' I put in Humber Valley as a major centre (40 sales in cache). It's a subdivision of Corner Brook technically. Mike: keep as own entry or fold into Corner Brook?
5. 'Brigus Junction' — I canonicalized it to 'Brigus' in nl-city-canonical.json. Mike: confirm or split.

6. The 'Pouch Cove' (103 sales) being above the 50-threshold means it gets its own dropdown entry, even though it's geographically part of Avalon. That's intentional — major centres appear in BOTH the 'Major centres' section (by name) and via 'Avalon Peninsula' selection (by region).
7. Connaigre Peninsula has zero major centres at the 50+ threshold. Whole region is small-community territory.
8. Northern Peninsula also has zero major centres at 50+ — St. Anthony only hits ~20-30 sales/2yr typically.
